# react-native-number-bloom

> Animated numbers for React Native. Digits roll, fade, and blur on value change. Skia-rendered, `Intl.NumberFormat` support, New Architecture only.

npm `react-native-number-bloom` • repo https://github.com/AlshehriAli0/react-native-number-bloom • MIT

## Install

```bash
bun add react-native-number-bloom @shopify/react-native-skia react-native-reanimated react-native-worklets
```

Peers: `react >=19`, `react-native >=0.78`, Skia `>=2`, Reanimated `>=4`, Worklets `>=0.5`. RN only (no web). Works with Expo dev builds and bare RN; **not Expo Go** (needs native modules + New Arch).

## Usage

```tsx
import { NumberBloom } from "react-native-number-bloom";

<NumberBloom
  value={price}                                       // number, required
  format={{ style: "currency", currency: "USD" }}     // Intl.NumberFormatOptions
  fontSize={32}
  color="#000"
/>
```

Drive `value` with state — animation is automatic. Component sizes to content; place inside a row `<View>` to inline with text. Only `value` tweens between renders; other props (`color`, `fontSize`, `format`, …) snap.

## Exports

```ts
import {
  NumberBloom,
  // defaults — handy when overriding one timing prop while keeping the rest
  DEFAULT_VALUE_TIMING, DEFAULT_ENTRANCE_TIMING, DEFAULT_SYMBOL_ENTRANCE_TIMING,
  DEFAULT_OPACITY_TIMING, DEFAULT_BLOOM_BLUR, DEFAULT_STAGGER_GAP_MS,
} from "react-native-number-bloom";
import type { NumberBloomProps, TimingConfig, ValueTiming } from "react-native-number-bloom";
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` | required | Negative numbers supported; the minus sign animates in/out via `symbolEntranceTiming`. `NaN`/`Infinity` render as `"NaN"`/`"∞"`; digits fall back to 0. Pass `0` during loading — `undefined` will throw. |
| `format` | `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` | — | `style: "currency" \| "percent" \| "unit" \| "decimal"`, `currency`, `notation: "compact"`, fraction digits, grouping, etc. |
| `locales` | `Intl.LocalesArgument` | — | BCP 47, e.g. `"en-US"`, `"de-DE"`. |
| `prefix` / `suffix` | `string` | — | Static text that animates in/out with the number. |
| `font` | `SkFont \| null` | system font | From `useFont(require("./Font.otf"), fontSize)`. Null while loading is safe. |
| `fontSize` | `number` | `16` | |
| `color` | `string` | `"black"` | |
| `letterSpacing` | `number` | `0` | |
| `animated` | `boolean` | `true` | `false` = instant snap, no tween. |
| `shouldAnimate` | `(prev, next) => boolean` | — | Per-update predicate; `true` animates, `false` snaps. `prev`/`next` are in the same space as `valueTiming`'s callback (i.e. percent is ×100). Ignored when `animated` is `false`. |
| `bloomBlur` | `number` | `2` | Blur radius. `0` disables bloom. |
| `maxIntegerDigits` | `number` | `5` | Pre-allocated digit slots. `5` fits 99,999; `6` fits 999,999. Pick the smallest that covers your max value. |
| `valueTiming` | `TimingConfig \| (prev, next) => TimingConfig` | scales with delta | Tween for the master value (digit roll). |
| `entranceTiming` | `TimingConfig` | 280ms `Easing.out(cubic)` | Digit slot width + blur. |
| `symbolEntranceTiming` | `TimingConfig` | 190ms `Easing.out(cubic)` | Commas, decimals, currency, sign. |
| `opacityTiming` | `TimingConfig` | 300ms `bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1)` | Slot opacity. |
| `staggerGap` | `number` | `150` | Min ms between consecutive bloom entrances. |
| `onAnimationStart` / `onAnimationEnd` | `() => void` | — | Per animated update, not per digit. |

```ts
interface TimingConfig { duration: number; easing: EasingFunction | EasingFunctionFactory; }
```

## Recipes

```tsx
// Percent — pass the DECIMAL (Intl multiplies by 100)
<NumberBloom value={0.42} format={{ style: "percent" }} />

// If your input is a whole percent (42 means "42%"), divide at the call site:
<NumberBloom value={p / 100} format={{ style: "percent" }} />

// Compact (1.2K, 3.4M)
<NumberBloom value={1234567} format={{ notation: "compact" }} />

// Locale
<NumberBloom value={1234.56} locales="de-DE" format={{ style: "currency", currency: "EUR" }} />

// Custom font — useFont comes from Skia, not this package
import { useFont } from "@shopify/react-native-skia";
const font = useFont(require("./Inter-Bold.otf"), 48);
<NumberBloom value={n} font={font} fontSize={48} />

// Inline with text
<View style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center" }}>
  <Text>You have </Text>
  <NumberBloom value={balance} format={{ style: "currency", currency: "USD" }} fontSize={18} />
</View>

// Snap, no animation
<NumberBloom value={n} animated={false} />

// Animate only meaningful changes — snap sub-cent jitter, snap huge catch-up jumps
<NumberBloom
  value={price}
  shouldAnimate={(prev, next) => {
    const delta = Math.abs(next - prev);
    return delta >= 0.01 && delta < 1000;
  }}
/>

// Animate from 0 on mount — first render snaps; trigger the tween by setting state after mount
const [n, setN] = useState(0);
useEffect(() => { setN(1234.56); }, []);
<NumberBloom value={n} />

// Delta-aware tween (big jumps last longer)
<NumberBloom
  value={n}
  valueTiming={(prev, next) => ({
    duration: Math.min(1200, 300 + Math.abs(next - prev) * 0.4),
    easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic),
  })}
/>

// Big numbers — raise the cap
<NumberBloom value={count} maxIntegerDigits={7} />
```

## Gotchas

- **Percent takes a decimal.** `0.42` → "42%". Passing `42` shows `4,200%`.
- **Set `maxIntegerDigits` to your max.** Default 5 = up to 99,999; pick the smallest that fits. Exceeding it still works but loses the perf win.
- **New Architecture required.** Won't work on the legacy renderer.
- **No children, no `style` prop.** Configure via the props above. For bold/italic, load a Skia font file with that weight.
- **Width animates with the value.** That's intentional — don't wrap in a fixed-width container unless you want clipping.
- **Not a `<Text>` node.** It's a Skia `<Canvas>`. Place as a sibling in row layouts, not inside `<Text>`.
